description_en: Queries the network information of a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterNetInfo接口查询指定集群的网络信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-cluster-net-info --db-cluster-id amv-wz9dqvn0o70000 --engine Clickhouse --resource-group-name example-string --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterNetInfo

parameters.description_en:
<props="china">The ID of an Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the details of clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs.

The database engine. Valid values:

- **AnalyticDB** (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.

- **ClickHouse**: the wide table engine.
